snippet.title: The Litter: Trigo - Trailer
snippet.description:
The Litter: Trigo is an educational math game that makes learning trigonometry easy and fun!
More than just a game, it's a full interactive math course with engaging explanations and exercises to help you finally understand trigonometry. Perfect for students, teachers, and anyone looking to improve their math skills!
